name: Plex
description: Watch history, metadata, settings and Plex's own database backups.
root_hint: Plex Media Server folder: /config in your Plex compose file (official and linuxserver images keep it under Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server there)

folders.label: Database and its backups
folders.description: Plex's database (watch history, libraries, settings) and the copies Plex makes of it every three days.

folders.label: Metadata
folders.description: Posters, artwork and details Plex downloaded for your media.

folders.label: Generated media
folders.description: Video preview thumbnails and other files Plex generated from your media.

folders.label: Cache
folders.description: Temporary files. Plex's own backup guide says you can leave it out.

pre_backup_script.name: Check Plex database backup
pre_backup_script.description: Stop the backup if Plex has not made a database backup in the last 100 hours.

notes: Keep Settings > Scheduled Tasks > Backup database every three days turned on in Plex. The live database can change while it is read; these dated copies are the ones to restore from.
Your movies and shows are not in this folder. Back up your media folders separately if you need to.
To restore a database copy, follow Plex's guide: https://support.plex.tv/articles/202485658-restore-a-database-backed-up-via-scheduled-tasks/
